overview_description.description:
Citus Data scales out PostgreSQL, taking relational power further for real-time applications. The CitusDB database offers a unique combination of massive parallelism, real-time reads/writes, and rich PostgreSQL expressiveness including native support for JSON data. The result is an extensible distributed database with an open ecosystem that powers interactive analytics and operational workloads -- making it simple for organizations to ingest, explore and aggregate billions of events on the fly.

Based in San Francisco, Citus Data is a Y Combinator alumnus, and is backed by investors that include Data Collective, Bullpen Capital and SV Angel. The CitusDB database is used by enterprises across multiple verticals, including e-commerce, retail, security, ad-tech and mobile analytics, and is available for download from the company’s website at www.citusdata.com.

about_short_description.short_description: Citus Data horizontally scales PostgreSQL, taking relational power further for real-time data.

product.name: Citus Open Source
product.description: An open source PostgreSQL extension that enables horizontal scaling by distributing tables and queries across multiple nodes.

identifier.value: Azure Cosmos DB for PostgreSQL (Citus Managed Service)

product.name: Azure Cosmos DB for PostgreSQL (Citus Managed Service)
product.description: A managed cloud database service on Azure that runs Citus to provide distributed Postgres with horizontal scaling and simplified management.

product.name: Distributed SQL Engine
product.description: A distributed query engine that parallelizes SQL queries across shards and nodes in a Citus cluster to improve query performance.

product.name: Schema-Based Sharding
product.description: A sharding method that distributes database schemas across multiple nodes, facilitating multi-tenant SaaS and microservices architectures without requiring a distribution key.

product.name: Row-Based Sharding
product.description: A traditional sharding method that distributes table rows across nodes based on a distribution key, suitable for real-time analytics, time series, and IoT workloads.

product.name: Columnar Storage
product.description: A storage format in Citus that compresses tables to reduce storage and I/O, enhancing query performance for analytical workloads.
